New here?

Your first session

No trial, no standard to meet, no forms before you've had a run. Whether you've played for years or never touched a rugby ball, this is how you start.

Step one

Turn up

It's free while you decide. Tuesday or Thursday, 6:45pm at Sedley Taylor Road. Boots if you have them, trainers if you don't.

Step two

Train

Join the session, meet the squad, find your level. Stay on after Thursday training: the bar's open and the club eats together.

Step three

Play Saturday

When you're ready, there's a shirt in one of four teams, from competitive first-team rugby to your first game in years.

Tell us you're coming
1946 · 2026

Our eightieth season

Founded in 1946 by old boys of the Cambridge and County High School for Boys, now Hills Road Sixth Form College, and at Sedley Taylor Road since 1953. Eighty years on, Cantabs is still what it was built to be: a proudly amateur club where anyone can play rugby, and everyone belongs after the final whistle. And the eightieth season starts with silverware on the shelf: 2025/26 finished as league and cup double winners.

Four teams · 2026/27

More than the eighty minutes

Club life

A clubhouse bar, Saturday teas and eighty years of stories. We're a family club, with a children's area in the clubhouse and families welcome at everything we do. You don't have to play to belong here.

Thursday team dinners

After training the whole club eats together. Every week, all teams, one table.

Annual beer festival

Our own festival at Sedley Taylor Road, open to everyone.

Tour and socials

A yearly tour and a social calendar that runs right through the season.
